logline: An elite narcotics detective is forcibly addicted to a new drug by an unknown enemy, then must operate undercover among his own suspects while a 20-year-old friendship murder and a hidden conspiracy converge on him.

bollymeter.basis: Averaged 9.2% nationwide ratings on SBS with the finale reaching 14.2%. Drama critic Park Jin-kyu (Korea Times) singled out Ji Sung's dual-state performance as the show's defining asset. Strong word-of-mouth among crime thriller audiences.

pull_quotes.text: Ji Sung showcases a contrast between the lifeless eyes of an addict and the sharp gaze of a detective on a mission.

seasons.review_body: Connection aired on SBS from May to July 2024 and delivered Ji Sung's most critically discussed performance in years. The series frames its detective procedural around an unusual structural premise: the protagonist Jang Jae-kyung is both investigator and victim, forcibly addicted to the drug cartel he is hunting. This double exposure - cop and addict, pursuer and prey - gave Ji Sung a textured performance space that drama critic Park Jin-kyu (Korea Times) praised explicitly, noting his 'contrast between the lifeless eyes of an addict and the sharp gaze of a detective.' The show averaged 9.2% nationwide ratings on SBS, climbing to 14.2% for its finale - a strong domestic result. The narrative interweaves a 20-year-old friendship-turned-murder conspiracy with the drug investigation, maintaining suspense across 14 episodes without overextending. Jeon Mi-do as the journalist old-friend co-lead grounds the emotional stakes. Minor criticism was directed at mid-season pacing dips, but the final run delivers.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere drops its inciting incident with unusual efficiency: Ji Sung's detective is compromised by the end of the first hour, and the show's structural irony - a narcotics cop addicted by his own targets - is established without delay.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Jang Jae-kyung wakes up with no memory of the past hours and a toxicology result that changes the entire story.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 14
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale pulls together the dual threads of the drug conspiracy and the two-decade friendship betrayal, rewarding patient viewers with confrontations that carry genuine emotional weight. The 14.2% rating reflects a domestic audience that followed the full run.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The face-off between Jang Jae-kyung and the figure behind his addiction - twenty years of misdirection resolved in a single scene.
